points.description: States that the leg bones must be large because they carry (support) the body's weight. Equivalent wording, such as 'they bear the weight of the body', earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that the leg bones are large because they carry or support the body's weight. The model answer is a single idea, so no partial credit is available. Give no mark for answers that only say the bones are strong or big without linking size to weight-bearing.
